north_star: control-plane owned evidence, Ray-first execution, data-plane by workload
adoption_order: 3. Spark batch pipelines for large training corpora
4. Flink for genuinely stateful real-time flows
anti_patterns: Do not replace the control plane with a scheduler.
Do not introduce Flink before there is a real streaming problem.
Do not let Spark own model-promotion or workflow semantics.
Do not start clusters from ordinary metadata inspection paths.

rows.name: batch_data_plane
rows.entry_condition: JSONL snapshots become too large or too numerous for local Python preparation

rows.name: streaming_data_plane
rows.entry_condition: continuous event throughput and stateful real-time decisions become material
